proposals.candidate_label: Degree-Aware Residual Propagation with Contrastive Neighborhoods
proposals.expected_signal: Moderate NDCG@10 lift if long-tail user/item interactions are under-smoothed by uniform propagation; strongest signal should appear as better ranking of less-popular positives without destabilizing ML
proposals.failure_mode: Residual path may preserve too much MF-like behavior, yielding negligible change; auxiliary contrastive term may collapse into popularity separation and add noise without ranking benefit
proposals.hypothesis: A useful lineage step beyond plain light graph propagation is to change the mechanism, not the scale: propagate with degree-aware residual mixing so sparse nodes retain more identity while dense nodes accept more neighborhood signal, then anchor embeddings with a lightweight user-item neighborhood contrastive auxiliary
